CZ Tax Depreciation Groups

The six Czech tax depreciation groups (odpisové skupiny 1–6) with their straight-line rates, accelerated coefficients and the § 30a extraordinary regime, for the tax depreciation board.

Version19.0.1.0.3
EditionCommunity and Enterprise
LicenceAGPL-3
Requiresaccount_asset_tax, l10n_cz

What it is for

Loads the Czech statutory depreciation groups (odpisové skupiny) into the tax depreciation module, account_asset_tax. With them, a Czech company can put an asset into a group and have its tax depreciation board (daňové odpisy) computed by the Czech rules: the full first-year rate whatever the month of putting into use, the higher first-year rates, accelerated depreciation in every group, and extraordinary depreciation of emission-free vehicles in group 2.

How the board is computed, and everything you do with it, is described in the tax depreciation guide.

Legal background

Act No. 586/1992 Sb. on income taxes:

  • § 30 odst. 1 — the groups and minimum depreciation periods; which group an asset belongs to is set by annex 1 to the act;
  • § 30 odst. 2 — straight-line or accelerated, chosen for each newly acquired asset and not changeable for its whole depreciation;
  • § 31 odst. 1 — the maximum straight-line rates, including the higher first-year rates of písm. b) to d);
  • § 32 odst. 1 — the accelerated coefficients;
  • § 30a — extraordinary depreciation of emission-free vehicles acquired from 1 January 2024 to 31 December 2028 by their first depreciator: 60 % and 40 % over 24 months.

The groups

Group Minimum period Straight-line rate — first year / later years / increased entry price (%) Accelerated coefficient — first year / later years / increased residual Extraordinary (§ 30a)
1 3 years 20 / 40 / 33.3 3 / 4 / 3 —
2 5 years 11 / 22.25 / 20 5 / 6 / 5 allowed
3 10 years 5.5 / 10.5 / 10 10 / 11 / 10 —
4 20 years 2.15 / 5.15 / 5.0 20 / 21 / 20 —
5 30 years 1.4 / 3.4 / 3.4 30 / 31 / 30 —
6 50 years 1.02 / 2.02 / 2.0 50 / 51 / 50 —

The higher first-year straight-line rates (§ 31 odst. 1 písm. b) to d)), for groups 1–3, are part of the calculation and chosen on the asset as Increased First-Year Rate:

Increase Group 1 Group 2 Group 3
+10 % 30 / 35 21 / 19.75 15.4 / 9.4
+15 % 35 / 32.5 26 / 18.5 19 / 9
+20 % 40 / 30 31 / 17.25 24.4 / 8.4

(first year / later years, % of the entry price)

The records are named Odpisová skupina 1 to 6 with codes CZ-1 to CZ-6, and appear in the asset's group field as, for example, CZ-2 — Odpisová skupina 2 (5 y).

Setting it up

Install it with the tax depreciation module and a bridge to your asset register (account_asset_tax_oca on Community, account_asset_tax_ee (delivered separately) on Enterprise). It requires Odoo's Czech localization (l10n_cz). There is nothing to configure: the groups are visible under Accounting → Configuration → Tax Depreciation Groups, and the asset form offers them to companies whose country is the Czech Republic. The values are reloaded every time the module is updated, so changes made by hand do not survive an update.

Limitations

  • Only the groups are loaded. Classifying an asset into a group is your decision; nothing suggests a group from the product or the account.
  • The +20 % rate belongs only to agricultural and forestry machinery of a predominantly agricultural taxpayer, the +15 % rate only to the equipment named in § 31 odst. 3, and all three only to first depreciators; nothing checks this.
  • Extraordinary depreciation is enabled on group 2 only, as the group of road vehicles; whether a vehicle is emission-free and qualifies is yours to confirm.
  • The board rounds to the haléř, not up to whole crowns as the act requires; this and the other deviations are listed in the tax depreciation guide.
